largest_gap_window.cause: The journals and transfers of assets that moved this account's value are CONDITIONAL-BY-COUNTERPARTY rows in the shared code table, and the served flow rule never reads them: classify_and_sum assigns _final = None for that class and resolves it later with `_final is None`, but on pandas 3.0.6 the list assignment turns the None into NaN, so no stage resolves a row and the row is not even counted as UNRESOLVED (census key ft_excluded_class-nan_rows). Window gap 1108912.92 = 1060000.00 from 6 cash journals (JNL cash rows, signed net -1060000.00 of value moved) that no term carries + 48912.92 from the cost basis of the in-kind lots that arrived or left (5 JNL/TOA legs; the lot table moves only the gain, so the basis part has no term) on 2026-09-02, 2026-09-03, 2026-09-14; a +958,986.00 / -958,986.00 pair on 2026-09-25 / 2026-09-28 nets to zero (the lot table lags the balance by one trading day on an in-kind journal out). Residual 0.0000. Counterfactually (the same producer with the None kept) every journal enters the flow and the window gap becomes -1607156.91 -- a SECOND cause that fixing the first exposes: an in-kind arrival carries a lot whose whole value is gain (cost basis 0 until the custodian posts it) and the flow also counts the arrival, so the identity needs an in-kind term.
